entries.en: Fixed a UI flicker where user input would briefly disappear after submission before the message rendered
entries.zh: 修复了用户输入在提交后、消息渲染之前会短暂消失的 UI 闪烁问题

entries.en: Fixed bulk agent kill (ctrl+f) to send a single aggregate notification instead of one per agent, and to properly clear the command queue
entries.zh: 修复了批量代理终止（ctrl+f）以发送单个聚合通知而不是每个代理一个，并正确清除命令队列

entries.en: Fixed graceful shutdown sometimes leaving stale sessions when using Remote Control by parallelizing teardown network calls
entries.zh: 通过并行拆卸网络调用，修复了使用远程控制时有时会留下陈旧会话的正常关闭问题

entries.en: Fixed `--worktree` sometimes being ignored on first launch
entries.zh: 修复了首次启动时有时会忽略`--worktree`的问题

entries.en: Fixed a panic ("switch on corrupted value") on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 上的恐慌（“打开损坏的值”）

entries.en: Fixed a crash that could occur when spawning many processes on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上生成多个进程时可能发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed a crash in the WebAssembly interpreter on Linux x64 & Windows x64
entries.zh: 修复了 Linux x64 和 Windows x64 上的 WebAssembly 解释器崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred after 2 minutes on Windows ARM64
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows ARM64 上有时 2 分钟后发生的崩溃
